params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate - Goo:}} {{cis|Zac}} abilities have a {{as|{{sti|health cost}}}}. Whenever '''Zac's''' abilities damage an enemy, he sheds a number of chunks on the ground that remain for a few seconds. '''Zac''' and enemy champions can collect the chunks; an enemy will destroy it, while '''Zac''' will {{tip|heal}} a portion of {{as|his '''maximum''' health}}.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Innate - Cell Division:}} Periodically when '''Zac''' would die, he instead enters {{tip|resurrection}} for a period, splitting into four ''bloblets'' that can be attacked by enemies. '''Zac''' will {{tip|death|die}} once all ''bloblets'' are killed.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate - The Secret Weapon:}} '''Zac''' gains increased percentage {{tip|size}} equal to {{as|{{fd|1.5}}% of his '''bonus''' health}}, capped at 35% increased size at {{as|{{fd|{{#expr:35/0.015 round 1}}{{recurring|3}}}} '''bonus''' health}}. '''Zac's''' size also reduces based on his {{as|'''missing''' health}}, down to 70% '''total''' size while at {{as|0% health}}.
params.description2:
{{sbc|Innate - Goo:}} Whenever '''Zac''' hits enemies with an {{tip|ability}}, he sheds a number of chunks of himself to a nearby location, landing towards nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy {{tip|champions}} and lasting for 6 seconds.
* ''{{ai|Stretching Strikes|Zac}}'': 1 chunk for the initial hit, and 1 chunk if the second hits a different enemy
* ''{{ai|Unstable Matter|Zac}}'': 1 chunk if it hits at least one enemy
* ''{{ai|Elastic Slingshot|Zac}}'': 1 chunk for each enemy champion hit, with a minimum of 1 if it hits at least one enemy
* ''{{ai|Let's Bounce!|Zac}}'': 1 chunk for each bounce that hits at least one enemy
params.description3: Both '''Zac''' and enemy champions can interact with a chunk by being within 50 units of it: an enemy will destroy it, while '''Zac''' will consume it to {{tip|heal}} for {{as|{{pp|key=%|4 + (8-4)/17*(x-1) for 20}} of his '''maximum''' health}}.
params.description4: {{sbc|Innate - Cell Division:}} Periodically, upon taking {{tip|death|fatal damage}}, '''Zac''' enters {{tip|resurrection}} for {{pp|8 to 4 for 5|1;6;10;13;17}} seconds, instantly restoring {{as|50% of his '''maximum''' health}} and becoming {{tip|untargetable}} and {{tip|lockout|unable to act}} for the duration. '''Zac''' then splits into four uncontrollable [[File:Cell_Division.png|20px|link=Zac#Pets]] ''[[Zac#Pets|bloblets]]'' away from his location, though stopping at terrain. After {{fd|1.5}} seconds of the ''bloblets'' being {{tip|untargetable}}, they start moving toward '''Zac's''' location over the {{tt|remaining duration|Regardless of distance}}. Any damage the ''bloblets'' receive, excluding damage dealt in excess of each ''bloblet's'' {{as|'''total maximum''' health}}, is also echoed to '''Zac''' as {{sti|{{as|true damage}}}}. While in resurrection, '''Zac''' cannot take damage from sources other than the echoed damage from his ''bloblets''.
params.description5: After the duration, '''Zac''' is revived with {{as|{{tt|10 – 50%|Based on his bloblets' total remaining health. Reaches the maximum amount at full health on all bloblets}} '''maximum''' health}}. '''Zac''' will be {{tip|execute|executed}} once all bloblets are killed.
params.description6: ''See [[Zac#Pets|Pets]] for stats and details for bloblets.''
params.range: {{tip|cr|icononly=true}} {{tt|700|Maximum straight-line bloblet split range, estimated. Bloblets will not go over terrain if their pathfinding length exceeds this range.}}
params.notes:
* The damage directed to '''Zac''' is {{tip|raw damage|internal raw damage}}.
* '''Zac's''' health when the ''bloblets'' are sent out is set to what it would be if all ''bloblets'' recombined, and is actively updated when the ''bloblets'' take damage.
* '''Zac's''' increased size does not consider his base stats.
* ''Cell Division's'' ''chunks'' spawn in two versions:
** {{sbc|Contestable:}} They will fall to the ground at a point which is roughly equidistant from '''Zac''' and the nearest {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy champion within 1000 range of him (dropping slightly in '''Zac's''' favor). The location at which they fall to the ground is influenced by the direction in which '''Zac''' is currently facing. Cannot be interacted with for the first {{fd|0.25}} seconds (except during {{ai|Let's Bounce!|Zac}}).
** {{sbc|Uncontestable:}} They will fall to the ground near '''Zac''' and can be picked up immediately (version used by default).
* '''Zac's''' {{tip|untargetability}} upon triggering ''Cell Division'' does not {{tip|homing projectile destruction|destroy}} in-flight {{tip|projectiles}}.
* {{ai|Chronoshift|Zilean}} and {{ii|Guardian Angel}} will take priority over ''Cell Division''.
* {{ii|Spirit Visage}} and {{sti|Heal Power|link=Heal and shield power}} increases the healing of both ''chunks'' and ''bloblets''.
* {{cai|Realm Warp|Ryze}} is able to individually teleport '''Zac''' or his ''bloblets'' during ''Cell Division''.
** If '''Zac''' is transported to a new location before the ''bloblets'' landed, they will travel to form at his new position, adjusting their speed accordingly. If ''Cell Division's'' duration permits during this time, '''Zac''' will be revived even if the ''bloblets'' fail to physically recombine.
* ''Cell Division's'' ''bloblets'' can be targeted by {{si|Teleport}} and {{cai|Force of Will|Syndra}}.
** Other ''bloblets'' are not interrupted by the conditions above and will continue to recombine instinctively.
* If '''Zac's''' health is higher than it is supposed to be when the ''bloblets'' converge on him, his health will be set to the correct value.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Zac}} stretches his arm in the target direction that briefly {{tip|slows}} and deals {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit based on {{as|his '''maximum''' health}}. He also forms a {{tip|true sight|revealing}} {{tip|tether}} with the target for a short time, during which his next {{tip|basic attack}} is replaced with a second ''Stretching Strike''.
params.blurb2: If the two ''Stretching Strikes'' hit different enemies, '''Zac''' will fling them together to briefly {{tip|airborne|knock up}} and {{tip|stun}} them, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to all surrounding enemies.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zac''' stretches his left arm in the target direction that catches the first enemy hit, dealing {{as|magic damage}}, {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 40% for {{fd|0.5}} seconds, and forming a {{tip|tether}} between '''Zac''' and the target for 2 seconds, during which they are {{tip|true sight|revealed}}.
params.leveling: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|60 to 180}} {{as|(+ 30% AP)}} {{as|(+ 3% of '''Zac's''' '''bonus''' health)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|60*2 to 180*2}} {{as|(+ 60% AP)}} {{as|(+ 6% of '''Zac's''' '''bonus''' health)}}}}
params.description2: While the tether persists, '''Zac's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} is replaced by a second ''Stretching Strike'', empowering it to have a {{fd|0.25}}-second cast time and gain {{sti|25 '''bonus''' attack range}}. This attack triggers {{tip|on-attack}} effects, but cannot {{tip|critically strike}} nor apply {{tip|on-hit}} effects.
params.description3: If the two ''Stretching Strikes'' affect different targets, both are {{tip|knockdown|knocked down}} and {{tip|root|rooted}} for {{tt|{{fd|0.5}}|Estimated}} seconds while the {{tt|secondary target|Target hit by the empowered attack (or second Stretching Strike in this context)}} is dealt the initial {{as|magic damage}} and applied the same {{tip|slow}}. After a {{tt|{{fd|0.4}}-second delay|After the attack's cast time}}, '''Zac''' {{tt|displaces|Only move block, does not stun the target's actions (disables attacking and movement only)}} them toward each other over 300 units, though not through terrain.
params.description4: If the two targets are within 700 units of each other, they are instead slammed together through the displacement. Upon impact of each other, both targets are {{tip|airborne|knocked up}} and {{tip|stun|stunned}} for {{fd|0.25}} seconds and all enemies within the impact are dealt the initial {{as|magic damage}} and applied the same {{tip|slow}}.
params.description5: ''Both Stretching Strikes (the cast and the empowered attack) {{tip|basic attack reset|reset}} '''Zac's''' basic attack timer. '''Zac''' is unable to move or attack while his left arm is in flight.''
params.notes:
* If both ''Stretching Strikes'' affect the same target, the target will be dealt the damage and applied the slow for both hits.
* The following features were added in patch [[V7.10]] to increase ''Stretching Strikes''' reliability and usability:
** If the second attack's target would die from the damage, it won't be dealt until they are slammed to the first target.
** If the first target is standing on top of other enemies, the second hit will reliably choose a different target from the first.
** Non-champion units that are affected by ''Stretching Strikes''' displacement are prevented from taking any damage until they are slammed together. Note that this often confuses players who are trying to secure {{tip|monster|monsters}} via {{si|Smite}} while '''Zac''' is slamming the wanted target, resulting in ''Smite'' dealing no damage to it. It is currently unknown whatever the side effects of this feature are intentional or not.
* The second ''Stretching Strike's'' empowered attack can trigger {{tip|Energized}} effects.
* {{tip|Spell shield|Spell shield's}} interactions with ''Stretching Strikes'':
** The first ''Stretching Strike'' will have its damage, slow, and tether application all blocked.
** If as the primary target and affected by the tether already from the first ''Stretching Strike'':
*** The damage and slow from the empowered attack if targeted again by the second ''Stretching Strike'' will be blocked.
*** The damage, slow, stun, and knock up from the impact of the second ''Stretching Strike'' hitting a different target will all be blocked, but not the root and the displacement.
** If as the primary target of the second ''Stretching Strike'', the root will be blocked, but the displacement, damage, slow, stun, and knock up afterwards will not.{{bug|2}}
** If as the secondary target of the impact, the damage and slow will be blocked.
* If the tethered target is {{tip|untargetable}} during the second ''Stretching Strike'' via basic attack, they are completely unaffected by the ability.
* {{tip|Displacement immunity}} will also resist the application of the {{tip|stun}}.
{{Effect at cast time end}}
* If the target becomes {{tip|untargetable}}, {{tip|death|dies}}, or is too far away during the empowered attack's cast time, it is cancelled but not consumed.
* If either target dies while being displaced towards the other, no slam occurs.{{bug|2}}

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Zac}} {{tip|channel|charges}} up to a few seconds, increasing the {{sti|range}} of his launch over a cone in the target direction.
params.blurb2: ''Elastic Slingshot'' can be recast within the duration and automatically does so afterwards, refunding half of the {{sti|{{as|health cost}}}} and {{sti|cdr|cooldown}}.
params.blurb3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Zac''' {{tip|dashes}} to the target location to deal {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit on impact and briefly {{tip|airborne|knock up}} and {{tip|stun}} them.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zac''' {{tip|channel|charges}} for up to {{fd|4.5}} seconds to increase ''Elastic Slingshot's'' range over a cone in the target direction.
params.description2: ''Elastic Slingshot'' can be recast within the duration. If '''Zac''' {{tt|cancels|See notes}} the channel himself, or the charge completes without reactivation, 50% of ''Elastic Slingshot's'' {{sti|{{as|health cost}}}} and {{sti|cooldown}} are refunded.
params.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Zac''' {{tip|dash|leaps}} to the target location within the boundaries of the cone. Upon landing, he deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|airborne|knocks them up}} and {{tip|stun|stuns}} them for {{fd|0.5}} seconds, increased to 1 second if ''Elastic Slingshot'' was charged for more than 1 second.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Zac}} bounces four times. Each impact deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit and briefly {{tip|airborne|knocks back}} and {{tip|slows}} them.
params.blurb2: During ''Let's Bounce!'', '''Zac''' can move, becomes {{tip|ghosted}}, gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed|ms}}}} and automatically consumes nearby ''{{ai|Cell Division|Zac|chunks}}''.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Zac''' bounces after the cast time, then bounces 3 additional times each second over 3 seconds. Each bounce deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit, {{tip|airborne|knocks them back}} over 1 second, and {{tip|slows}} them by 20% for the same duration. An enemy can be hit by multiple bounces, but ones beyond the first deal 50% damage to them and do not apply the {{tip|airborne|knock back}}.
